_readme: Known obstacles in the OptiTrack arena, for the LLM features' route planning
(typed moves, camera-search moves, missions). Manual position commands are not checked.
Each obstacle is an upright box. Track it live: make a Motive rigid body for it
(markers on the lid), stream it, and give its name as /vrpn_mocap/<name>/pose.
size = [x, y, z] of the box in metres, in the rigid body's own (yaw) frame.
center_offset = vector from the rigid body pivot to the box centre, same frame;
default [0, 0, -size_z/2] = pivot on the top centre (set the pivot there in Motive).
Fixed boxes instead: give "position" (box centre) and "yaw_deg" in place of topic.
A tracked obstacle with no pose for stale_s seconds blocks every LLM route.
margin_m: how far the drone centre stays from a box footprint (T650 ~0.65 m tip to tip).
clearance_m: drone centre over (or under) a box's top; 0.4 leaves room for the landing gear
(gear height NOT measured -- check it on the real T650 and raise this if needed).
tracking_tolerance_m: routes are planned this much beyond margin_m, for the controller's
tracking error (sim: 0.12 m overshoot measured); what is flown then stays outside margin_m.
margin_m 0.7 from the drone centre leaves ~0.19 m between the T650's prop tips and the box.
